items.raw_excerpt: LED hoarding near Tirusulam causes driver distraction, safety concerns, and traffic chaos, prompting calls for brightness reduction and better coordination.
items.summary_en: A large LED billboard near Tirusulam is so bright that drivers take their eyes off the road. Local people also point to people crossing the road without waiting and breaking traffic rules nearby. Police and residents want the board dimmed and better traffic control around it.
items.summary_ko: 치루술람 근처 대형 LED 광고판이 너무 밝아 운전자의 시선을 빼앗아 안전 문제가 커지고 있다. 지역 사람들은 버스를 기다리지 않고 길을 건너는 행동과 교통 법규 위반도 문제로 함께 지적한다. 경찰과 주민은 광고판 밝기를 낮추고 주변 통제를 개선해 달라고 요구한다.
items.title_en: Big LED billboard distracts drivers near Tirusulam
items.title_ko: 치루술람 대형 LED 광고판이 운전자 시선 왜곡해 안전 우려
items.title_original: LED hoarding, jaywalking, and traffic violations pose safety concerns near Tirusulam

items.raw_excerpt: The Singaporean will next face Malaysia's Justin Hoh later on Saturday.
items.summary_en: Singapore's Loh Kean Yew beat India's Lakshya Sen in a badminton match at the Asian Games. He now moves into the last 16. Later on Saturday, he will play Malaysia's Justin Hoh.

items.summary_en: Copenhagen Health Week starts this week. You can also sign up for the Royal Run and the Hermitage Run races. Here is a look at more events on the calendar.

items.raw_excerpt: Despite optimistic promises, the Perth writers' festival hasn't been scheduled since 2024. For writers and reader on the west coast, it's a deeply felt loss.
items.summary_en: The Perth writers festival has not been held since 2024, even though people were promised it would return. Perth is now the only Australian capital city without a major writers festival. Writers and readers on the west coast feel this loss.
items.summary_ko: 퍼스 작가 축제는 2024년 이후로 열리지 않고 있다. 재개 약속만 나온 상태다. 퍼스는 이제 대형 작가 축제가 없는 호주 유일의 오수도다. 서부 해안의 작가와 독자들은 이 상실을 크게 느낀다.
items.title_en: Perth Has No Big Writers Festival Anymore

items.title_original: Perth now only capital without major writers' festival

items.raw_excerpt: For these enthusiasts, the set-up is part of the "magic" and has earned them thousands of followers.
items.summary_en: Every year, a group of local vloggers arrive early to record the start of Goose Fair. For them, the tradition has become its own kind of magic and has earned them thousands of followers.

items.raw_excerpt: Britain's Newcastle University has faced criticism for awarding a sustainability professorship to Anant Ambani, an oil billionaire's son and the owner of the scandal-hit Vantara wildlife center in India.
items.summary_en: Newcastle University in England gave a professorship to Anant Ambani, the son of an oil billionaire. He owns Vantara, a wildlife center in India that has been criticized. Many people were angry about the appointment.

items.raw_excerpt: From faith in football to an almighty Olympics row and Daddy Pig being among the runners in this year's Berlin Marathon, Inside Germany is our weekly look at some of the talking points that you may have missed.
items.summary_en: Every week, we look at the things people in Germany are talking about. This week: hope in football, a big row over the Olympics, and Daddy Pig running in the Berlin Marathon.

items.raw_excerpt: The AFL grand final has never felt so raw as in the five ballistic minutes that elevated the Brisbane Lions to legends and delivered Fremantle the most crushing defeat imaginable.
items.summary_en: Brisbane Lions came back from a late three-point deficit to beat Fremantle in the AFL grand final. Only the Lions believed they could win it. The final is being called the greatest and cruellest grand final in history.

items.title_en: Brisbane Lions Win the AFL Grand Final in a Comeback

items.raw_excerpt: Late-night openings at bars and nightclubs fell by almost 1,000 in 2025, prompting calls to reduce licensing costs.

items.raw_excerpt: The Lux Interior festival, scheduled for Coimbra across three dates in October and November and marking the event’s seventh edition, celebrates the 30th anniversary of the Lux Records label and promises six great concerts, the event’s promoter says.
items.summary_en: A music festival will take place in Coimbra this year. The Lux Interior festival runs on three dates in October and November. This is its seventh edition, and it marks 30 years of the Lux Records label.

items.summary_en: Stephanie Phillips tells how she felt that listening to indie and punk music in her youth meant betraying her own race. She looks back at that feeling and at the history of Black people in alternative music.
